segments.text: Welcome. It's time to let the day go. Lie back, and let yourself be held by the bed beneath you.
There's nothing left to do now. Nowhere to be. Just here, just resting.
Take a slow breath in through your nose. And a long, soft breath out.
Again. Breathing in calm. And breathing out the weight of the day.
Let your jaw soften. Let your shoulders sink down, away from your ears.
Feel your arms growing heavy. Your hands, still and warm.
With every breath out, you sink a little deeper into rest.
There is nothing to hold onto. Let your thoughts drift by like clouds.
Your body is heavy now. Calm. Safe.
Let the quiet carry you. Drift, gently, toward sleep.
Rest now. I'll let you go. Sleep well.
